reference.title: Fujifilm Fujichrome Velvia 100 Professional developed 135 slide film reference
reference.license: Linked for study only; reference photograph not redistributed. Runtime lettering and geometry are original project artwork (ISC).
reference.limitations: Lettering, frame and half-frame numbers reconstructed from developed 135/120 references. Optical code tracks are omitted per slide film standard. Placement normalized to five frames; font and base color are approximations, not calibrated measurements.
